properties.name: A tool description sits close enough to its budget that two added sentences fail the lint AND the rank ratchet, and the second failure is caused by the first
properties.statement:
Measured 2026-09-20 adding two sentences to gap_to_prompt's description: the lint failed at 1,624 characters against a 1,500 budget, and `no_new_mutually_confusable_pair` failed in the same run. They look like two problems and are one. The ranking scorer divides by a length term, so lengthening a description lowers its own scores and can move a neighbour into or out of a top-five list; a baseline pair therefore came apart. Trimming to 1,479 cleared both, and all five ranking tests passed unchanged.

⭐ THE ORDER THAT SAVES A RUN: build, `toolsnap.py --update`, then read the description's length BEFORE running the ratchet, because the ratchet takes about 38 seconds and the length check takes none. A description near the budget is the signal; 1,479 of 1,500 leaves room for roughly one sentence.

AND THE GENERAL SHAPE, which is why this is worth a record rather than a note: the served text is an input to two different gates with different failure messages, so a single edit reports twice and neither message names the other. The measurement is the link between them.
